senses.gloss: f. (an assumed word for כַּלְבָּה, after the form of לְבִיָּא) she-dog, bitch.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 39:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXIX</cite> (in an allegorical contest of the limbs) <he>הא לך חלב כ׳</he> here is dog-milk for thee, ed. Bub. <cite ref="K00680"><he>כלבא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 721:1">Yalk. Ps. 721</cite> <cite ref="K00687"><he>כלבתא</he></cite> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 721:1">Ib.</cite> <he>הבאת חלב כ׳</he> (read with Yalk. l. c. <cite ref="K00678"><he>כַּלְבָּא</he></cite>; ed. Bub. <cite ref="K00687"><he>כלבתא</he></cite>) thou hast brought dog-(instead of lion-) milk. Ib. <he>ועוד ג״כ כי לבייא קורין אותה כ׳</he> (differ. in Yalk.; ed. Bub. <he>ועוד ללבייא … כלבתא</he>) and furthermore a lioness may likewise be called a bitch.
